name: Tasigur, the Golden Fang
description: A Sultai leader who set a Mardu warrior free and sent ambassadors with infectious rats.

description_citations.text: Fate Reforged: card flavor text (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Mardu warrior is set free by Tasigur and given passage through the jungle, not noticing the Sultai leader's cruel smile.
timeline.quote: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle.

citation.text: Douse in Gloom (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tasigur sends ambassadors to an Abzan outpost, bringing infectious rats as the true envoys.
timeline.quote: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.

citation.text: Typhoid Rats (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: He is the young, pampered heir to the Sultai fortune.
relations.quote: Tasigur, the Golden Fang is the young, pampered heir to the Sultai fortune.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

pages_say.description: The young, pampered heir to the Sultai fortune, a cruel hedonist carried on a platform by zombies.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.
